::: {.page-banner}
# Application Details
:::

::: grid


::: {.g-col-6 .text_block}
Building on two decades of experience, the 2026 Summer School offers a unique opportunity for PhD candidates and early-career academics in communication, sociology, psychology and political science:

- to attend an immersive, five-day program that comprises lectures, master classes, paper presentations, and mentoring sessions; and
- to build long-lasting personal and scholarly relations in a celebrated friendly and productive environment.


Participation in the ICA Political Communication Summer School will be on a competitive basis. Individuals interested in being considered will need to complete an [application form](https://polcomm.github.io/summer-school/participation/application.html), which requires the submission of standard academic information, a CV, and a political communication research proposal or extended abstract (max. three pages). Applicants must also have an academic referee directly submit a recommendation letter to [cdp@leeds.ac.uk](mailto: cdp@leeds.ac.uk) no longer than the deadline. Applications are considered complete only after the recommendation letter has been received.

An international selection committee will evaluate applications based on scholarly quality, fit with the Summer School, and cohort diversity.

### Key Information

-	The Summer School begins Monday at 9:00, and ends Friday at 17:30.
-	Enrollment fee: £550 (covers accommodation at Devonshire Hall beginning Sunday night, with checkout on Saturday, as well as all lunches and refreshments).
-	Application deadline for participants: March 30 (23:59 GMT)
-	Notifications of application status: April 15


### Application Form

- Access the Application form [here](https://polcomm.github.io/summer-school/participation/application.html).
